title: Te Tangata i Whakaingoatia i roto i te Whare o te Poropiti
intro: I roto i te whare o te karere whakamutunga, i noho tētahi wairua, ko tana kōrero whaiaro i waiho hei akoranga tapu mā te hunga whakapono katoa. I hono tata te oranga o tēnei tangata ki tētahi whakahau whakarerekē i huri i ngā tikanga pāpori ake ake, e tohu ana i tētahi panonitanga nui ki te āhua o te whakapono e tautuhi ana i te whānau me te noho tahi.
clues: I mua i honoa tōku ingoa ki tētahi whakapapa rangatira, engari mā tētahi pono teitei ake e whakamārama i ngā here pono o te whakapono.
I whiwhi ahau i te manaakitanga nui mai i a Allah me tana karere, he manaakitanga i whakapuakina nuitia i roto i te Pukapuka.
I riro tōku oranga marena hei whakamātautau nui, ā, ka huri ake tonu atu te tirohanga ki ngā whanaungatanga whāngai.
Ko au te tangata nāna i ārahi te whakamātautau whaiaro ki tētahi whakahau a te Atua i whakaae ai te Peropheta ki te marena i tētahi wahine i muri i taku wehenga atu.
Nā roto i taku kōrero, i mārama ai te rerekētanga i waenga i te whānau tuturu me te whānau whiriwhiri, mō ngā whakatipuranga katoa.
Ko au anake te tangata o ōku hoa e puta marama ana tōna ingoa i roto i te whakakitenga whakamutunga, ehara i te mea he poropiti, engari he pononga i whakamatautauria, i whakahonoretia.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
